entities.summary: Emma Rafowicz is a French politician of the Socialist Party (PS). She was elected member of the European Parliament in 2024. She is currently serving as president of the Young Socialist Movement and municipal councillor of the 11th arrondissement of Paris, after having served as Deputy mayor from 2020 to 2024.
